notes.1: This unit is Eisenstein's own introduction to the work, in modern Hebrew, not the Book of Raziel itself. Years are in the short Hebrew count: [5]461 = 1700/01, [5]553 = 1792/93, [5]580 = 1819/20, [5]587 = 1826/27, [5]600 = 1839/40, [5]572 = 1811/12. יעב״ץ is read as Rabbi Jacob Emden; 'the Rokeah' is the author of that work (Eleazar of Worms). 'After a hundred and thirty years of his repentance' (אחר ק״ל שנה לתשובתו) may mean 130 years into his penitence or after it. Places: הוראדנא Grodno, קאפוסט Kopys, אוסטראה Ostroh, לבוב Lviv (Lemberg).

nodes.text: The Book of Raziel, or Raziel the Angel: it is a very ancient book of speculative and practical Kabbalah, on all the orders of the host of heaven and the names of the angels, the work of creation, prayers, formulas for amulets, and adjurations of angels, spirits and demons, and part of the Book of the Stature, or Shi'ur Komah [Measure of the Stature], of Rabbi Ishmael ben Elisha the High Priest. And it is written on the title page of the book that the angel Raziel handed this book to the first Adam after a hundred and thirty years of his repentance, and he handed it on to Noah and to Shem and to Abraham, etc., until King Solomon arose, and the Book of Mysteries was revealed to him, and many books were delivered into his hand, and this one was found more precious and honoured than all of them (Amsterdam printing, folio 34a).

The Book of Raziel was known to Rabbi Abraham ibn Ezra, who mentions it in his commentary on the Torah (Exodus 14:19), in these words: ‘And in the Book of Raziel: whoever wishes to make a dream-question should read at the beginning of the night the verse And it came to pass in the thirtieth year, for it has seventy-two letters.’ But in the book before us, in the matter of the dream-question, Ibn Ezra's wording is not found (see folio 40), and it seems that he had a different version. And Rabbi Jacob Emden wrote that the Book of Raziel is a forgery (Torat ha-Kena'ot, folio 49a, in a note). In the opinion of Zunz it was composed in the time of the Geonim, but many things from a later time were included in it; and in his view the body of the Book of Raziel comprises only the whole of the Book of the Garment (at its beginning) and most of the Book of Mysteries, or the Book of Noah (at its end). But the Great Book of Raziel that is within it — which is a kind of commentary on Sefer Yetzirah and the work of creation and the Name of Seventy-Two, etc. — is from a later time, and he inclines to attribute this part to the author of the Rokeah. In the opinion of Fürst it is the book Sodei Razaya [Secrets of the Mystery] by the Rokeah. And some attribute it to Rabbi Abraham Abulafia, the well-known visionary, who called himself by the name Raziel. The Book of Raziel was first printed in Amsterdam in the year [5]461, with illustrations, and in it is the first printed picture of the Shield of David. And it was printed afterwards in Grodno [5]553, Kopys [5]580, Ostroh [5]587, Lviv [5]600, and, with corrections and glosses, Warsaw [5]572.
